Prima Porta — Rome, Italy

🟡 Local press research

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Prima Porta is a large zone on Rome's northern edge, dominated by the vast Cimitero Flaminio (Rome's largest cemetery) and blocks of public housing alongside ordinary residential streets. It appears repeatedly in 2026 Carabinieri operations: a drug-dealing ring described as moving roughly 2 million euros a year between Prima Porta, Labaro and the Tuscia was dismantled with 21 precautionary measures, and separate sweeps cleared informal encampments and made arrests for predatory crime and urban decay here. Local outlets have also documented years of neglect at the cemetery itself - an upkeep issue rather than a safety one. Daytime around the cemetery and shops is unremarkable; night carries a real, press-documented risk tied to drug dealing and localized degrado.
